title: Madras High Court says driving at high speed on ring road is not negligence since...
description: The Madras High Court recently held that driving vehicles at high speeds on a road meant for fast travel cannot by itself be treated as negligence in a motor accident case [Tata AIG Vs P Ammu].A Bench of Justices CV Karthikeyan and K Rajasekar made the observation while dismissing an appeal filed by Tata AIG General Insurance Company against an award of ₹2.92 crore compensation to the family of an Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) scientist who died in a road accident.The case concerned
